summary: The state diagram depicts a cyclic relationship among STARTUP, OPERATIONS, and SHUTDOWN that is entirely absent from the textual requirements. While all states are present in both text and diagram, all states are reachable, and no deadlocks exist, the diagram includes three transitions that are not described in the text. The text only specifies that STARTUP is the initial state upon power application and that states are mutually exclusive.
